kaikki_vikisozluk.e: صُوّة • (ṣuwwa) f (plural صُوًى (ṣuwan, construct state صُوَى (ṣuwā)) or أَصْواء (ʔaṣwāʔ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ص و و (ṣ w w) or ص و ي (ṣ w y), meaning “to be rough or dry”, “to be rugged”, “rugged elevated ground”, stemming from the Bedouin practice of using rock outcroppings to determine bearings in deserts with sparse landmarks; cognate with Old South Arabian 𐩮𐩥𐩺 (ṣwy, “to signify, to indicate (direction)”).
s: Old South Arabian 𐩮𐩥𐩺 (ṣwy, “to signify, to indicate (direction)”)
g: an elevation of terrain marking an orographic transition, a foothill, barrow, mound
